name: beam_rider
mechanic: PERSPECTIVE LANE SHOOTER (faithful to Activision Beamrider 1983). VIEW: a receding 3D 'beam grid' tunnel (SEE THE REFERENCE IMAGE for the look): 5 vertical beams (the lanes) TOGETHER WITH horizontal cross-rungs, all converging toward a vanishing point near the top-center, forming a webbed plane you look down into — NOT a bare fan/starburst of lines. Dark background, bright grid lines. Keep all grid lines and entities thick and bright enough to stay legible after the frame is downscaled to 64x64 (avoid 1-2px lines that disappear). The player Light Ship sits at the BOTTOM on exactly ONE of the 5 beams and never moves vertically. Enemies spawn AT the vanishing point and travel DOWN a beam toward the player, GROWING larger as they approach (perspective scaling) — this rushing-toward-you cadence is the core feel, NOT a flat vertical shooter. CONTROLS: LEFT/RIGHT snap the ship one beam left/right (discrete lane change, clamp at edges); D fires a LASER up the current beam (unlimited, ~8-12 frame cooldown); UP fires a TORPEDO up the current beam (LIMITED to 3 per sector, an ammo counter). The laser-vs-torpedo economy is central: torpedoes are scarce and are the only way to kill the Sentinel and certain enemies. ENEMIES (spawn at vanishing point, descend a beam, scale up; may jitter between adjacent beams as they descend): White Saucer = primary target, destroyed by LASER, must destroy 15 to clear the sector; Brown Space Debris = CANNOT be shot, must be DODGED by changing beams (collision = lose a life). Keep 2-3 enemy types live at once for learnability. SENTINEL SHIP: after the 15 white saucers are destroyed, a Sentinel Ship crosses horizontally across the top; hit it with a TORPEDO for a big bonus (plus bonus per remaining torpedo), then the sector clears (respawn enemies, refill torpedoes to 3, increase enemy speed and spawn rate). YELLOW REJUVENATOR: occasionally descends a beam; if the ship TOUCHES it gain +1 life, but if SHOT it turns into damaging debris (collision = lose a life). LIVES: start with 3; lose one on collision with debris or a saucer reaching your beam; 0 lives = GAMEOVER. SCORING (RL-tuned, relative feel preserved): white saucer via laser +25; enemy via torpedo +50; Sentinel via torpedo +300 plus +50 per remaining torpedo; catch a Rejuvenator +100 and +1 life; clear a sector +200; no negative reward for wasted shots or lost lives. SEED controls: spawn beam choices, spawn timing, per-spawn enemy-type mix, Rejuvenator timing/beam, Sentinel crossing direction — seed must NOT change speeds, rules, or scoring. FEEL PRIORITIES: (1) lane-snapped movement across a converging perspective grid; (2) enemies descend the beams and scale up with perspective; (3) laser-unlimited vs torpedo-3/sector economy; (4) 15 saucers -> Sentinel -> sector-clear loop; (5) brown debris dodged not shot.
